# Bizstim

> Bizstim is an all-in-one small business software platform providing CRM, appointment scheduling, client management, billing, and accounting solutions for diverse service industries.

Bizstim serves small businesses across multiple verticals including childcare, driving schools, healthcare clinics, therapy practices, and tutoring services. The platform emphasizes ease of use, data migration support, and flexible pricing with no long-term contracts.

## Key Topics

- Small Business Software
- CRM (Customer Relationship Management)
- Appointment Scheduling
- Payment Processing
- Billing & Accounting
- REST API
- HIPAA Compliance
- Client Management
- Free Trial
- Data Migration
- Stripe Integration
- QuickBooks Integration
- No Contracts
- Referral Program
- API Documentation

## Industry Solutions

- [Childcare & Daycare Software](https://www.bizstim.com/business-software/child-care-center-software): Bizstim childcare software: scheduling, check-in, waiting lists, parent portal
- [Driving School Software](https://www.bizstim.com/business-software/driving-school-software): Bizstim driving school software: scheduling, mileage tracking, billing
- [Health Clinics Software](https://www.bizstim.com/business-software/appointment-financial-software-health-clinics): Bizstim healthcare software: HIPAA-compliant scheduling, patient records, payments
- [Therapy & Counseling Software](https://www.bizstim.com/business-software/client-relations-management-therapists): Bizstim therapy software: CRM, scheduling, assessment reporting for therapists
- [Tutoring Business Software](https://www.bizstim.com/business-software/online-scheduling-accounting-software-tutoring): Bizstim tutoring software: scheduling, accounting, payroll, student assessment
